transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well, I'm just here because... I haven't been myself lately. Ever since my friend from choir passed away—it was so sudden—I just... I don't know. I cry over silly things, like the potluck sign-up lists. And I get all worked up and anxious about phone calls that I used to handle with no problem. I've even started missing the church planning meetings, and I never used to miss those. It's just been really hard.
I'm so sorry for your loss. How long ago did your friend pass away?

Thank you. Um, she passed away just about a month ago. And... well, it was really only after that sudden loss that I started falling apart with all the church planning and everything else. I was doing just fine before that.
Have you been having repeated, unwanted memories or nightmares about her passing?

No, I haven't really had anything like that. I don't have nightmares or... or memories popping up when I don't want them to. It's just more of a general sadness and feeling overwhelmed, but not specific memories like that.
Aside from church planning, have you lost interest or pleasure in the hobbies and activities you normally enjoy?

No, I wouldn't say that. I still enjoy my usual things. I mean... I might not get around to them quite as much right now just because I'm feeling so overwhelmed, but I haven't lost interest. The things I usually like to do, I do still enjoy them when I sit down to do them.
